messages.text:
I’ve set up a combined proposal for **R$389.80** for the tin and straw set. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. A staff member must also approve it before it can be paid. [refund-policy/v2/approval]

It doesn’t mean the bank will pay you immediately. In this demo, a receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for when money appears on a card. [refund-policy/v2/payout]
